label: preparing
what: A community meal/community bread gathering at six in the town hall great hall; the innkeeper is organizing it with Freight and the builder. The neighbour knowingly kept the earlier conversation private and asked to join/help, and the secretary confirmed the six-o'clock great-hall arrangement, but direct evidence of the neighbour or secretary helping prepare is limited. The mayor was not told about the preparation beforehand; he was later told the appointment was a community meal.
